# Truthifi MCP server

> Hosted MCP server at https://api.truthifi.com/mcp (Streamable HTTP, OAuth with Dynamic Client Registration). Lets AI assistants read a user's own linked investment and bank accounts from 18,000+ supported institutions (it can't move money or place trades; three tools change data inside Truthifi only): holdings, fees, performance, cash flow and the Truthifi Score. Registry name com.truthifi/mcp.

## Docs
- [README](https://github.com/truthifi/truthifi-mcp#readme): quick start for every client
- [Tools](https://github.com/truthifi/truthifi-mcp/blob/main/docs/tools.md): all 29 tools, credits, plans and which tools change data
- [Install for agents](https://github.com/truthifi/truthifi-mcp/blob/main/llms-install.md)
- [Security and privacy](https://github.com/truthifi/truthifi-mcp/blob/main/docs/security-and-privacy.md)
- [Connect guides](https://truthifi.com/connect)
- [Product page](https://truthifi.com/features/mcp)
